gaps: Two candidates that felt like returns conserved nothing: the returned letter reports that the destination is gone, and the slump that ends by regression carries no mechanism at all. Conservation stopped being the criterion; the live question became what the return does with the absence it crosses, which produced breath two.
accepted: Silent gene: a trait returns after generations of absence because its code was kept unexpressed, as when a whale is born with hind limbs; what returns was never absent, only silent, which separates it from convergence, where the trait is rebuilt from nothing.

Natal stream: a salmon returns by an olfactory imprint of the water it hatched in, spawns, and dies, so the return is completed by offspring who never departed; a returner who survives its arrival is migrating, not returning in this sense.

Scar in the washbasin: the returner is unrecognizable except by one old mark and one witness who remembers it, as Odysseus is known by his dog and by the nurse who finds the scar while washing his feet; sameness lives in the recognizer, so the return cannot be asserted, only received, and it dies with the last witness.

Carriage return: the typewriter head goes back to the left margin while the platen advances one line, landing on the same column of a row that did not exist before; one coordinate is exactly regained and the other is irreversibly advanced, so no point is ever revisited, which separates it from any cycle.

Halley's appointment: the comet returns to the same sky every seventy-six years while every witness of the last passage is dead, so the return is kept as a prediction handed to successors, as Halley named a return he could not live to see; a seasonal return, seen twice by one person, is not this.

Reentry burn: the road back is the road out crossed at a different speed, so a capsule that rose gently through the atmosphere must shed its whole orbital energy as heat coming down; the road is open and hostile in one direction only, which is not the same as a road that has closed.

Stack unwind: a recursive call returns through every frame it passed, in reverse order, and each frame adds its share so that the answer exists only on the way back; a return that skips a frame is a crash, not a shortcut.

Pigeon in a box: a homing pigeon carried away in a closed box returns without any record of the outward road, computing a route from the destination alone; the return is navigated, not retraced, so it succeeds only if the destination has a signature that can be sensed from afar.

Agamemnon's bath: the returner's slot was kept open as king and husband and the household filled that slot with a plan, so the return delivers him to the trap the absence built; the place changed because of the absence, not merely during it.

Regression to the mean: a slumping player returns to form and nothing returned, because the slump was noise and the average reasserted itself; a relapse into a conserved basin is told from this by whether any intervention could have held, since here there was nothing to hold.

residue.item: Pendulum's return: the bob comes back to the same point with reversed velocity.
residue.why: Rejected: at the turning point position and velocity both recur exactly, so this is a bare cycle in which no conservation fails; Halley's appointment already carries the cycle and adds the witness turnover that makes it a return rather than a period.

residue.item: Relapse: the state comes back because its basin of attraction was conserved even after the person left it.
residue.why: Merged into Regression to the mean as its discriminator: the two are told apart by whether an intervention could have held, and as a separate item relapse added a familiar name, not a second mechanism.

residue.item: Boomerang: the return is designed into the throw.
residue.why: Held: the return is the second half of one motion and no absence intervenes in which conservation could fail; it becomes interesting only when the thrower has moved, which is Pigeon in a box inverted.

residue.item: Rip Van Winkle: the sleeper returns to a village that has changed regime.
residue.why: Rejected: an example of the place changing, not a mechanism; the mechanism it points at, one clock running while another stops, is carried by Halley's appointment and Reentry burn without the costume.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an exhaustive typology; one actual return may run several of these mechanisms at once, as a restitution can also be a reunion pageant.
The seriation orders where the licensing sameness is kept and what the return does with its interval, not value, difficulty, or historical order; edges are conditional authored claims.
Reconsolidation is used for the shape of its mechanism on the strength of a contested laboratory literature; the item does not claim the science is settled.
Literary cases (Odysseus, Agamemnon) stand in for mechanisms that recur; the map does not claim they are the origin or best instance of those mechanisms.
The sonar seed, in which the return's delay measures the road it crossed, is left outside because it turned the list toward instruments; it is recorded as the best unresolved seed.

gaps: Asking what the return does with the interval split the record-keeping returns into filing (Writ returned), erasing (Hard reset), pricing (Open-box refund), and rewriting (Reconsolidation), and split the witness-dependent returns into performance (Reunion pageant), nomination (Restitution to a descendant), and verdict (Return to sender). Reprise was the surprise: an interval that changes only the hearer. The title was kept because the item type still holds; the criterion under it changed from conservation to what the return does with the absence.
accepted: Writ returned: a sheriff returns the writ to the court endorsed with what was done, and a tax return renders an account of the year, so the document comes back inscribed with its own interval; a thing that comes back unmarked is a refund, not a return of this kind.

Hard reset: restoring a backup returns a file to its past state and deletes whatever grew in the interval, as git reset --hard does where git revert would return the content while keeping the interval as history; this return counts by pretending the absence never happened.

Open-box refund: the buyer returns the item and receives the full price while the item goes back on the shelf marked open-box at a discount; fungible value returns whole and the particular returns marked, so the cost of the interval is priced onto the thing, never onto the money.

Reconsolidation: recalling a memory makes it labile and re-stores it altered, so each return to a memory rewrites it and the most revisited memories are the least original (a laboratory finding whose scope is still contested); this is not forgetting, since the memory returns vivid and changed.

Reprise: the theme returns note for note after the development and sounds like a homecoming only because the hearer has been away; the notes are unchanged and the hearer is not, which separates it from reconsolidation, where the notes drift and the hearer feels no change.

Reunion pageant: at a class reunion the place performs its former self for the returners and the returners perform their former selves for each other, on a set date, with a script; sameness is manufactured at arrival by coordinated pretense, which is a mechanism and not a mood.

Restitution to a descendant: the Benin bronzes return to a Nigeria in which the palace they were taken from was burned and the kingdom is a state within a state, so the return must nominate who receives them; not a refund, since nothing equivalent is substituted, and not a return to a place, since the place has to be chosen.

Return to sender: a letter comes back stamped addressee unknown, so the return is a verdict that the destination no longer exists, learned only because the envelope could not stay; not a bounce from a closed road, where the destination may still be there.

residue.item: Sample return: the probe comes back carrying a gram of asteroid; the returner is a container and its identity is irrelevant.
residue.why: Merged into Writ returned: both are returns that come back loaded, and the difference between carrying an account of the interval and carrying a piece of elsewhere is a difference of cargo, not of mechanism.

residue.item: Ghost: a return that never completes, stuck at the arrival it cannot leave.
residue.why: Rejected: without a carrier for the sticking it is a mood; the nearest mechanism, a slot kept open and filled against the returner, is Agamemnon's bath.

residue.item: Return of the repressed: what was excluded comes back in disguise as a symptom, recognizable only by the shape of its distortion.
residue.why: Held as speculative residue: fertile, but it needs a case in which the disguise can be verified independently of the interpretation; otherwise every symptom qualifies and the item cannot be refuted.

residue.item: Sonar ping: the return's delay measures the road it crossed, so the return is the only thing that was ever sent and the shape of the far wall is its news.
residue.why: Best unresolved seed: a genuine mechanism, but it turned the list toward returns as instruments, where nothing departed in the sense the item type needs; it wants its own list of returns that measure.

neighbors.left: Reconsolidation: recalling a memory makes it labile and re-stores it altered, so each return to a memory rewrites it and the most revisited memories are the least original (a laboratory finding whose scope is still contested); this is not forgetting, since the memory returns vivid and changed.
neighbors.right: Reprise: the theme returns note for note after the development and sounds like a homecoming only because the hearer has been away; the notes are unchanged and the hearer is not, which separates it from reconsolidation, where the notes drift and the hearer feels no change.
neighbors.separating_case: Play a recording of a melody twice: the second hearing is a reprise, bitwise identical, moving because of what the hearer did between plays. Hum the melody from memory twice: the second humming drifts from the first, and the hummer feels no change. The recording separates the two because it cannot reconsolidate.

checks.boundary_case: Deja vu is a felt return with no departure, so there is no interval whose conservation could be tested and nothing for the return to do with an absence; it belongs to a list of false-recognition mechanisms, not here.
checks.form_inference: The map forks Stack unwind from Pigeon in a box on whether the outward road was recorded, a fact fixed at departure that a sequence cannot show. It closes a loop between Reconsolidation and Reunion pageant: private recall rewrites what the reunion performs, and the performance is re-stored as recall, so the two cannot be ordered. It passes between levels at Natal stream to Restitution to a descendant, where the returning individual is replaced by a lineage that must nominate its recipient.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each admitted item names a distinct carrier of sameness and a distinct fate for the interval; the strange members (a return completed by heirs, a return that is a verdict of nonexistence, a return with nothing behind it) were kept strange rather than folded into homecoming.

next_crossfield_opening: Returns that measure: connect Sonar ping with Return to sender and with the deleted-witness cases in traces-of-the-unlived; ask what a return can report only because the destination failed to hold it.

gaps: Critic's strongest objection: the map reached for absolutes its own cases falsify, worst on the load-bearing passage edge Natal stream to Restitution to a descendant, whose antecedent (the returner cannot survive to arrive) holds for the salmon and fails for the bronzes, where the returner is intact and the recipient is what did not survive; the same habit produced 'every witness dead' (1910 and 1986 overlap), 'skipping a frame is a crash' (exceptions skip by design), 'never onto the money' (restocking fees), a typewriter head that moves, a destination that 'no longer exists', and a pigeon sensing a signature from afar. All clause repairs; no cut needed.
accepted: Natal stream: a salmon homes on the smell of the water it hatched in and, arriving, spawns and dies, so the one who is home afterward is offspring who never departed and the returner is spent by its own arrival; a homing that leaves the returner alive to be boxed and flown out again is Pigeon in a box, not this.

Carriage return: the typewriter carriage goes back to the left margin while the platen advances one line, so the next stroke lands on the same column of a row that did not exist before; one coordinate is exactly regained and the other is irreversibly advanced, so no point is ever revisited, which separates it from any cycle.

Halley's appointment: the comet returns to the same sky every seventy-six years, about one life, so the return is kept as a prediction handed to successors who never saw the last passage, as Halley named a return he could not live to see; a return kept by a witness who saw it before, as a season is, is not this, even when a rare witness lives to see the comet twice.

Stack unwind: a recursive call returns through every frame it passed, in reverse order, and each frame adds its share so that the answer exists only on the way back; a return that skips frames, as a thrown exception does, arrives with no answer, so it is an escape, not a shortcut.

Pigeon in a box: a homing pigeon carried away in a closed box returns without any record of the outward road, so the return is navigated, not retraced, from a field that spans both places and a remembered value of home within it (how pigeons do this is still contested); it fails wherever the field does not reach, not wherever the road was long.

Open-box refund: the buyer returns the item and receives the full price while the item goes back on the shelf marked open-box at a discount; fungible value returns whole and the particular returns marked, so the cost of the interval is priced onto the thing, where a restocking fee would price it onto the money instead.

Reunion pageant: at a class reunion the place performs its former self for the returners and the returners perform their former selves for each other, on a set date, with a script, so sameness is manufactured at arrival by coordinated pretense; a return that finds its sameness ready-made, as a reprise does, needs no pageant, and a pageant with no returners is a festival.

Reprise: the theme returns note for note after a contrasting section, as a rondo refrain does, and sounds like a homecoming only because the hearer has been away; the notes are unchanged and the hearer is not, which separates it from reconsolidation, where the notes drift and the hearer feels no change.

Return to sender: a letter comes back stamped addressee unknown, so the return is a verdict that the addressee and the address came apart during the interval, learned only because the envelope could not stay; not a bounce from a closed road, where the destination may still be there and reachable later.
limits: Pigeon in a box now rests on a contested navigation literature (gradient-map hypothesis) and is marked as such, folded into the existing Reconsolidation limit.
seed: The place's side of the interval. The changed question asked what the return does with the absence; its mirror, what the place does with the absence, is only glimpsed here from the returner's end (Agamemnon's bath fills the slot with a plan; Return to sender lets name and address drift apart; Reunion pageant rehearses). A list of what a place does with an absence, with revenge, forgetting the address, keeping the room as it was, and reassigning the slot as first inhabitants, would let this map's edges be read from both ends, and the author's sonar seed is a special case of it in which the place answers with a delay.
